title: Ɔkra a Ɔhaw no Boasetɔ
intro: Wɔ abakɔsɛm mu abakɔsɛm mu no, onipa bi wɔ hɔ a ne din ne boasetɔ yɛ ade koro. Wɔsɔɔ saa onipa yi hwɛe sɛ ɔhweree wiase ahotɔ biara, nanso ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ Ɔbɔadeɛ no somfo a ɔde ne ho ama. Wɔ mfe pii ahokyere ne honam fam yare mu no, ɔkra yi koma kɔɔ so gyinaa gyidi mu, na ɛmaa wɔn a wohyia amanehunu nyinaa nyaa anidaso kanea.
clues: Na meyɛ Allah akoa a ɔde ne ho ama, a ahonyadeɛ bebree, mma bebree, ne akwahosan pa nhyira me.
M’asetra danee bere a wogyee m’ahonyade ne m’abusua fii me nsam, na ɛmaa minnyaa biribiara gye me gyidi.
Yare bi a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ na ɛyɛ yaw a ɛsɔɔ nnipa boasetɔ anohyeto ankasa hwɛe na ɛhaw me.
Wɔ m’amanehunu nyinaa mu no, mepowee sɛ mɛnwiinwii atia m’Awurade, bere mpo a ɔtamfo no bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔde me bɛkɔ abasamtu mu no.
Bere a awiei koraa no mefrɛɛ m’Awurade no, mansrɛ ahonyade, na mmom migye toom kɛkɛ sɛ ahoyeraw aka me.
Wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ memfa me nan mmɔ asase no, na nsuo a ɛyɛ nwini asubura bi firii mu baeɛ a ɛbɛsa me nipadua yareɛ na adum me sukɔm.

arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
